title: Solar Flat-Plate Collector Instantaneous Efficiency
description: Single-day Hottel-Whillier-Bliss flat-plate solar thermal collector (Type 1) driven by synthetic diurnal weather (Type 15) and tabular output printer (Type 25).
code:
* Flat-Plate Solar Collector Instantaneous Thermal Efficiency
VERSION 18
SIMULATION 0 24 0.5
TOLERANCES 0.001 0.001
LIMITS 30 30 30

UNIT 1 TYPE 15 Weather
PARAMETERS 5
  20.0 6.0 3060.0 6.0 18.0

UNIT 2 TYPE 1 Collector
PARAMETERS 5
  4.0 4.19 0.78 14.5 0.05
INPUTS 4
  0,0 0,0 1,1 1,2
  25.0 200.0 20.0 0.0

UNIT 3 TYPE 25 Printer
PARAMETERS 4
  1.0 0.0 24.0 30
INPUTS 4
  1,1 1,2 2,1 2,3
  T_amb I_sol T_out Q_useful

END

* Companion TMY weather table: weather_tmy.csv

  20.0 250.0 0.0

PARAMETERS 5
  6.0 4.19 0.77 14.0 0.02

  3,1 3,2 1,1 1,2
  20.0 0.0 21.0 0.0

PARAMETERS 4
  1.0 0.0 72.0 32

  2,1 4,1 5,3 4,3

END

title: District Solar-Plus-Thermal-Storage Microgrid
description: Integrated district heating solar-thermal microgrid combining a collector field (Type 1), differential controller (Type 2), circulation pump (Type 3), stratified central storage (Type 4), forcing schedule (Type 14), building cluster load (Type 56), and companion weather and demand CSV datasets.
code:
* District Solar-Plus-Thermal-Storage Microgrid Simulation
* Companion datasets: weather_tmy.csv and heat_demand.csv
VERSION 18
SIMULATION 0 168 0.25
TOLERANCES 0.001 0.001
LIMITS 50 50 50

CONSTANTS 2
  COLL_AREA = 120.0
  TANK_VOL = 12.0

UNIT 1 TYPE 15 WeatherTMY
PARAMETERS 5
  14.0 6.0 2880.0 6.5 18.5

UNIT 2 TYPE 14 DistrictDemandSched

  0.0 0.4 10.0 1.0 24.0 0.4

  5 92.0

  5,1 6,1 6,3 3,1 0,0 0,0
  35.0 30.0 30.0 0.0 8.0 2.0

UNIT 4 TYPE 3 FieldPump
PARAMETERS 4
  4500.0 4.19 2400.0 0.04
INPUTS 3
  6,1 0,0 3,1
  30.0 4500.0 0.0

UNIT 5 TYPE 1 SolarCollectorField
PARAMETERS 5
  120.0 4.19 0.79 13.5 0.02
INPUTS 4
  4,1 4,2 1,1 1,2
  30.0 0.0 14.0 0.0

UNIT 6 TYPE 4 CentralThermalTank
PARAMETERS 6
  12.0 4.19 1000.0 0.8 4.0 6
INPUTS 5
  5,1 5,2 0,0 0,0 1,1
  30.0 0.0 25.0 800.0 14.0
DERIVATIVES 6
  40.0 42.0 44.0 46.0 48.0 50.0

UNIT 7 TYPE 56 DistrictBuildingCluster

  45000.0 950.0 40.0 21.0

  1,1 1,2 0,0 6,5
  14.0 0.0 8000.0 0.0

UNIT 8 TYPE 25 Printer
PARAMETERS 4
  1.0 0.0 168.0 34
INPUTS 4
  5,3 6,3 7,1 3,1
  Q_solar T_tank_top T_cluster PumpOn

END
